A close outside the 00-06 UTC range during the first two hours after 08:00 London may continue as European liquidity arrives.

budget: 4 primary hypotheses. One lower and one higher sensitivity per hypothesis, +/-20% (London window +/-30 minutes). No parameter selection. One sealed evaluation only for survivors.
execution: Use next observed minute bid OHLC, one outstanding order per strategy, conservative ambiguous bars, 1h entry expiry, 4h maximum hold. Bid/ask if observed, otherwise assumed spread USD 0.50 and market slippage USD 0.10; stress doubles costs. ATR risk, target 1.5R. Decision calendar weekdays, no weekend fills. Drop first and last 24 hours of each fold to embargo crossing labels, refuse unobservable paths.

gates.bootstrap: 2000 circular five-trading-day block replicates, seed 1951, include flat days. One-sided Bonferroni 0.05/4 lower bound above zero for total daily net R and paired differences vs both active references.
gates.other: Require positive net expectancy in each half, positive stressed expectancy, both neighbors positive in validation, no missing-path materiality (>1% of orders). Final year must pass the same economic gates and uncertainty checks. Confirm 60 forward trading days and 50 closed forward fills before owner review. RESEARCH -> SHADOW only after historical gates. APPROVED requires owner.

sources: Local use only. Prefer HistData M1, use MT5 if unavailable with timestamp validation. April 2023 bid/ask tick sample reserved for execution audit. Exclude all Phase 1 prices from performance measurement.
